1. Extend the image with the border mode by half its size, at most 256 pixels, on each side.
2. Start with f equal to the extended image g and p equal to 0.
3. Move p along the gradient of f bar and pull every vector back into the disk of radius lambda.
4. Move f along the divergence of p and solve the data term exactly with the FFT.
5. Set f bar to 2 f' - f, and repeat for the chosen number of iterations.
6. Crop the last estimate to the image.
